models.title: Role-play · at the supermarket (customer and employee)

block.label: ROLE-PLAY · CAN YOU HELP ME?
block.html:
Luana is at the supermarket with a shopping list. She needs help. Then change roles!
Useful: Excuse me, where can I find…? · Is there any…? · How much is…? · How much are…? · Can I pay by card?

roles.name: Customer (Luana)
roles.card: Your list: bread, milk, a few eggs, some apples, coffee, rice. Ask where the products are and how much they cost. One product is missing: ask for something else. At the checkout, pay and ask for the receipt.

roles.name: Employee and cashier (teacher)
roles.card: Help the customer: the rice is in aisle 3, the milk is next to the cheese. There isn't any bread today: offer cookies or cake. Coffee is on sale. At the checkout, ask: Cash or card? Do you need a bag? Give the change and the receipt.

blocks.label: READING · PAULA'S SATURDAY
blocks.html:
Paula lives with her husband and two children. Every Saturday morning, she goes to the supermarket near her house. She usually takes a big cart because she buys a lot of food for the week. She always starts in the fruit and vegetable section. Her children eat many apples and bananas, so she buys a lot of fruit. She doesn't buy much meat, because the family prefers fish and chicken. At the checkout, she pays with her card and puts everything in her bags.

Today is different. It's Saturday, but Paula isn't shopping with her children. They are playing football at school. Paula is walking down the aisles alone, and she is looking at her list. There isn't any bread on the shelf, so she is asking an employee for help. She is also buying some milk and a few eggs. The supermarket is very busy today: there are many people in the line, and Paula doesn't have much time. She needs to be home at 11 o'clock.
